title: selaginella presliana
intro: Selaginella presliana, commonly known as Spikemoss, is a type of non-vascular, epiphytic plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella presliana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cognitive function, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
